lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaa meraa govi(n)d agam agochar aad nira(n)jan nira(n)kaar jeeu ||
lines.translation: My Lord of the Universe is great, unapproachable, unfathomable, primal, immaculate and formless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਅਮਿਤਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee gat kahee na jaaee amit vadiaaee meraa govi(n)d alakh apaar jeeu ||
lines.translation: His condition cannot be described; His Glorious Greatness is immeasurable. My Lord of the Universe is invisible and infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਆਪੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: govi(n)d alakh apaar apara(n)par aap aapanaa jaanai ||
lines.translation: The Lord of the Universe is invisible, infinite and unlimited. He Himself knows Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਇਹ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa ih ja(n)t vichaare kaheeahi jo tudh aakh vakhaanai ||
lines.translation: What should these poor creatures say? How can they speak of and describe You?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਅਪਣੀ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no nadar karahi too(n) apanee so guramukh kare veechaar jeeu ||
lines.translation: That Gurmukh who is blessed by Your Glance of Grace contemplates You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਆਦਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: vadaa meraa govi(n)d agam agochar aad nira(n)jan nira(n)kaar jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: My Lord of the Universe is great, unapproachable, unfathomable, primal, immaculate and formless. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aad purakh apara(n)par karataa teraa paar na paaiaa jaai jeeu ||
lines.translation: You, O Lord, O Primal Being, are the Limitless Creator; Your limits cannot be found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਘਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) ghat ghat a(n)tar sarab nira(n)tar sabh mahi rahiaa samaai jeeu ||
lines.translation: You are pervading and permeating each and every heart, everywhere, You are contained in all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat a(n)tar paarabraham paramesar taa kaa a(n)t na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Within the heart is the Transcendent, Supreme Lord God, whose limits cannot be found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis roop na rekh adisat agochar guramukh alakh lakhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He has no form or shape; He is unseen and unknown. The Gurmukh sees the unseen Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahai din raatee sahaje naam samaai jeeu ||
lines.translation: He remains in continual ecstasy, day and night, and is spontaneously absorbed into the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aad purakh apara(n)par karataa teraa paar na paaiaa jaai jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: You, O Lord, O Primal Being, are the Limitless Creator; Your limits cannot be found. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) sat paramesar sadaa abinaasee har har gunee nidhaan jeeu ||
lines.translation: You are the True, Transcendent Lord, forever imperishable. The Lord, Har, Har, is the treasure of virtue.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har prabh eko avar na koee too(n) aape purakh sujaan jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Lord God, Har, Har, is the One and only; there is no other at all. You Yourself are the all-knowing Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ਤੂੰ ਪਰਧਾਨੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: purakh sujaan too(n) paradhaan tudh jevad avar na koee ||
lines.translation: You are the all-knowing Lord, the most exalted and auspicious; there is no other as great as You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਭੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਵਰਤਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa sabad sabh too(n)hai varatahi too(n) aape karahi s hoee ||
lines.translation: The Word of Your Shabad is pervading in all; whatever You do, comes to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sabh mahi raviaa eko soee guramukh lakhiaa har naam jeeu ||
lines.translation: The One Lord God is permeating all; the Gurmukh comes to understand the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਤਿ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) sat paramesar sadaa abinaasee har har gunee nidhaan jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: You are the True, Transcendent Lord, forever imperishable. The Lord, Har, Har, is the treasure of virtue. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh too(n)hai karataa sabh teree vadiaaee jiu bhaavai tivai chalaai jeeu ||
lines.translation: You are the Creator of all, and all greatness is Yours. As it pleases Your Will, so do we act.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਵਹਿ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh aape bhaavai tivai chalaavahi sabh terai sabad samaai jeeu ||
lines.translation: As it pleases Your Will, so do we act. All are merged into Your Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sabad samaavai jaa(n) tudh bhaavai terai sabad vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: When it pleases Your Will, we obtain greatness through Your Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh budh paaeeai aap gavaaeeai sabade rahiaa samaaee ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh obtains wisdom, and eliminates his self-conceit, and remains absorbed in the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa sabad agochar guramukh paaeeai naanak naam samaai jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh obtains Your incomprehensible Shabad; O Nanak, he remains merged in the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਤੂੰਹੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਚਲਾਇ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: sabh too(n)hai karataa sabh teree vadiaaee jiu bhaavai tivai chalaai jeeu ||4||7||14||
lines.translation: You are the Creator of all, and all greatness is Yours. As it pleases Your Will, so do we act. ||4||7||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 chha(n)t ghar 4 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, Chhant, Fourth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਿੰਨੇ ਲੋਇਣਾ ਮਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਰਤੰਨਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har a(n)mrit bhi(n)ne loinaa man prem rata(n)naa raam raaje ||
lines.translation: My eyes are wet with the Nectar of the Lord, and my mind is imbued with His Love, O Lord King.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮਿ ਕਸਵਟੀ ਲਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਸੋਵਿੰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man raam kasavatee laaiaa ka(n)chan sovi(n)naa ||
lines.translation: The Lord applied His touch-stone to my mind, and found it one hundred per cent gold.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੋ ਭਿੰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh ra(n)g chalooliaa meraa man tano bhi(n)naa ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, I am dyed in the deep red of the poppy, and my mind and body are drenched with His Love.
